plant: n_next=2n+u-q_t with n in [-1,1], u in [-2,10], q_t in {0,8}

architectures.same_step: current q information arrives before current write
architectures.positive_delay: at write t, encoder/controller information contains q only through t-d for integer d>=1
architectures.preview: a charged current q symbol arrives before current write despite delayed raw sensing
architectures.predictable_control: q_t is constant and a charged initial q seed is supplied before safety begins

quantifiers.disturbance: every arbitrary q word in the main delayed architecture
quantifiers.safety: every initial normal state and every time from the first write
